Prepare first 250 movies for user data collection

```{r}
m250 <- con_imdb$leer("250") %>% 
  mutate(fl250 = "Y",
         title_join = str_to_lower(name) %>%
           str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:]]", ""))

imdb_link <- "https://www.imdb.com/title/"

movies250 <- con_imdb$leer("title_basics") %>%  
  filter( titleType %in% c("movie", "tvMovie")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(na_if(startYear, "\\N")),
         dur = as.numeric(na_if(runtimeMinutes, "\\N")),
         genres = ifelse(genres == "\\N", "", genres ),
         title_join = str_to_lower(primaryTitle) |>  
           str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:]]", "")) %>%
  filter(year >= 1900 & year <= 2025) %>%
  select(tconst, titleType, primaryTitle, genres, year, title_join) %>%
#   # ADD IMDB raitings
   left_join(con_imdb$leer("title_ratings"), by = c("tconst")) %>% 
  mutate(rate = as.numeric(averageRating),
         votes = as.numeric(numVotes),
         link = paste0(imdb_link, tconst)) %>%
  # ADD 250 popular movies
  inner_join(m250,
             by = c("year", "title_join" )) %>%
  select(-c("averageRating", "numVotes", "name")) %>%
  filter(fl250 == "Y") %>% 
  collect() %>% 
  select(-c("fl250")) %>% 
  arrange(is.na(rate), desc(rate),  desc(year), desc(votes))  

# Check what movies did not match
# m250 %>% collect() %>% left_join(movies250, by = c("title_join", "year")) %>% view()
 
view(movies250) 
```

Search and scrape data using bing and python

```{r}
query <- "Finding HAPPY 2025 movie" 

url_img <- paste0(
  "https://www.bing.com/images/search?q=",
  URLencode(paste(query, "poster"))
)

url_country <- paste0(
  "https://www.bing.com/search?q=",
  URLencode(paste(query, "country origin"))
)

html_img <- system2(
  "curl",
  c(
    "-L",
    "--user-agent", "Mozilla/5.0", 
    url_img
  ),
  stdout = TRUE
)

html_country <- system2(
  "curl",
  c(
    "-L",
    "--user-agent", "Mozilla/5.0",
    url_country
  ),
  stdout = TRUE
)

html_img_data <- paste(html_img, collapse = "\n")
html_country_data <- paste(html_country, collapse = "\n")

scripts$get_images(html_img_data) %>% length()

```
